category: other: spatula slipped out of the grasp while the blade was pushed into the pot
what_happened: Scene: layout 10, small black pot (Pot071) on the rear-left zone of an electric hob, sweet potato and mushroom on the counter right of the hob, spatula_6 (teal handle, yellow blade) by a utensil rail. Stage 0: sweet potato grasped 104, dropped in 191 (complete 194). Stage 1: mushroom grasped 334, dropped in 439 (complete 445). Stage 2: a first close at 550 hit nothing; second close 582 on the spatula near its blade, lifted (complete 607/616). Stage 3: from ~720 the blade stood vertically in the pot and the arm worked it there for ~200 steps (720-920); the env counted 2 of the 5 required stir steps (success_time 2). At ~920 the spatula slipped out of the fingers (width 0.019 at 912 -> 0.003 at 928; stage 2 ends 922) and fell into the pot, lying across the mushroom with the handle over the rim. The fingers stayed closed (0.001) for the remaining ~680 steps while the arm hovered over the pot and then off to the side; no re-grasp.
causal_chain: blade in the pot 720-920, only 2 of 5 stir steps counted -> spatula slid out of the fingers ~920 (stage 2 undone) -> gripper stayed closed, no re-grasp 928-1600 -> success_time stuck at 2
official_criterion_notes: Near miss: success_time reached 2 of 5. Each counted step needs both vegetables to move > 0.5 mm in that step and the spatula to touch veg1 (the sweet potato here); the wrist view at 928 shows the blade on the mushroom (veg2), which alone never counts. Packet first_incomplete_stage is 2 only because PickUpSpatula is evaluated as 'held and lifted now' (not latched); the online log completed stages 0-2, so the failed stage is 3.

packet_facts: close 550 on nothing; close 582 width 0.019 lifted; stage2 616-922

uncertain_about: Which vegetable the blade touched during the 2 counted steps; why the counter did not advance during most of the 200 steps in the pot (contact with veg1 vs simultaneous movement of both cannot be read from the video).
